name: unclaimedgrant-native
description: Unclaimed Grants — native Android and iOS apps

scripts.build:android: node prepare.mjs && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.build:ios: node prepare.mjs && npx cap sync ios && cd ios/App && xcodebuild -workspace App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release -archivePath build/App.xcarchive archive
